root_cause: Visa commercial credit card transactions are experiencing fee downgrades due to missing Level 2/3 enhanced transaction data.
diagnosis: The merchant was charged higher interchange fees totaling Rs 683.28 across 7 transactions because commercial card Level 2/3 line-item data was not passed to the processor, triggering a downgrade penalty. Note that benchmark comparisons are based on an illustrative source status.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2 and Level 3 data fields during authorization satisfies commercial card qualification requirements and prevents fee downgrades.
